discrepancyClassifications.detailedOnlyRationale: Legacy scraped Japanese entries with missing physical card numbers or unparseable raw placeholder strings, excluded from IR shard generation to prevent compiler corruption.
discrepancyClassifications.shardsOnlyRationale: Official promotional releases, collaboration sets (Digimon, Kamen Rider, Gundam, Evangelion, Ultraman), and specialty tournament distributions compiled directly into set shards.
discrepancyClassifications.reprintDuplicatesRationale: Canonical Battle Spirits reprints sharing the identical canonical card number (e.g. BS01-001 reprinted in BSC22 with alternate art), preserved physically per release set shard.
discrepancyClassifications.sqliteCardsV2ExtraRationale: Synthetic composite IDs introduced during legacy database migration, mapping to canonical cards without modifying gameplay.
